published_title: Type II LS that wins from Info Broker
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Info Broker''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
description: LS Sucks in the EP1 Format if you ask me, but if you want something that wins without Podracing..which I hate Podracing...then go with this.
cards: posted: A Vergence In The Force x2
posted: Mindful Of the Future x5 (use one to start)
posted: Too Close For Comfort x2
posted: Speak With The Jedi Council
We Wish To Board At Once
posted: We Wish To Board At Once x2
posted: Reveal Ourselves To The Jedi x2
notes: Starting cards as posted: Tatooine: Slave Quarters ('(start)', no Objective), A Tragedy Has Occurred ('(Start)') and one Mindful Of The Future ('x5 (use one to start)'); these count toward the 60.

The description calls this a deck for 'the EP1 Format' (Type II, Episode I-only sets); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set Light printings are used for Coruscant, Tatooine, Sense and Alter. The post's tag reads 'Dark' but the list is Light.

Posted 'Threepio Naked' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (Tatooine; the Premiere C-3PO is not Episode I); 'Obi-Wan Kenobi' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (Tatooine; the Premiere Obi-Wan is not legal in the EP1 format); 'Yoda, Council Member' dested Yoda, Senior Council Member; 'Altar' dested Alter; 'Padme' Naberrie' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Tatooine Slave Quarters' dested the Tatooine-set site, not the (V) page.
The strategy says 'I start the Grabber'; no grabber card is named in the list.
The same author posted a Dark Type II list, 'Type II from Guzman' (DeckTech 19113), two days earlier.
